key_impacts: PHIVOLCS issued tsunami alert level 3 prompting immediate coastal evacuations.
All surveyed barangays reported high evacuation rates (about 80% on average).
No significant tsunami wave appeared and no damages were observed in the Philippines.
Communication issues during the alert: power cuts, mobile network problems, and one radio station broadcast wrong information.
evidence_snippets: On 31 August 2012 … an earthquake … reached a magnitude of 7.6.
At 09:01 pm PHIVOLCS issued alert level 3, meaning immediate evacuation.
All surveyed barangays had an estimated average of 80% of the residents evacuating after the alert.
missing_information: Specific list of all affected municipalities beyond Guiuan and the provinces surveyed is not fully enumerated.
Precise evacuation counts by locality are not provided.
